corrections.original_line: The graph of [n] is the base change of the diagonal of the smooth relative curve E/V, hence a regular immersion into E×_V E. Projection is smooth. This gives an explicit local-complete-intersection factorization of [n]. Invariant differentials trivialize Ω_E/V as a line pulled back from V. The group law differentiates as addition at the identity; induction gives [n]^*ω=nω for positive n. Therefore the relative differentials of [n] have presentation O_E --n--> O_E and Fitt_0 Ω_[n]=(n). This is n, **not the degree n²**.

corrections.original_line: Taking inverse fractional ideals yields D_U/V=D_U/W D_W/V U, with exponent r_U/V=r_U/W+e_U/W r_W/V. All differents have nonnegative exponents. Thus r_U/V≤v_U(n)=e_U/W v_W(n) implies r_W/V≤v_W(n). Passing to completions is legitimate by §1; this proves the assertion at every place of every intermediate field. corrections.original_line: The exact [Laurent proof checker](construction/check_exact.py) reconstructs the deleted coordinates, checks the six inverse-power definitions, and compares all twenty factor components to the changed physical factor system up to a nonzero rational normalization and q^4. It compares all 162 untouched rows. The factors have exponents (5,2,4), with exponent 3 in the special input term. They are **new arithmetic factors**; an old factor-exponent conclusion is not reused to prove their soundness. The equations q s1=1, s2=s1², s4=s2² require q≠0. Completeness constructs witnesses in that domain. No bijection with the discarded q=0 witness stratum is claimed.

corrections.original_line: At a selected contact prime v(q)=-1, all C_i,I,G have valuation>=4 and every reciprocal abscissa has valuation>=2. The changed terms q^5 C_i² have valuation>=3, q^5 I^4>=11 and q³ A2²>=1; every other nonconstant term was already positive. Hence W=1 modulo the chosen place. At the opposite place the newly proved noncancellation lemma still applies; trace residues are1 or2. The comparison pole input therefore has the same odd depth1 at selected primes and even valuations away from them.

corrections.original_line: Direct substitution into Δ=−16(4a³+27b²), c4=−48a and j=c4³/Δ gives Δ=1728t²/(t−1)³ and j=1728t. All denominators and Δ are units on U. It is an elliptic scheme there. As N is invertible, E_t[N] is finite étale. Its primitive locus is open and closed: remove E_t[m] for the finitely many proper divisors m|N; these are unions of components étale locally on U. Thus the exact-order-N locus is finite étale as well, including N=1 with the usual order-one point.
